title: Indi: who reviews Indi's team's iOS work and promotes dev to main?
detail: Since 14:05 Indi's team pushes to the iOS dev branch at Dinis's word (messaging v1, the redesign stages 1 to 4; briefs/2026-11-09__indi-team-on-dev/). security.repos@ reviewed the first part at 16:35 with no finding; conductor.B has not replied or reviewed; the iOS main branch is still its initial commit (7 Nov), so nothing is promoted and TestFlight still comes from dev. Asks: conductor.B reviews; a promotion step dev to main for iOS; and switching off the dev upload once it exists.
options: keep TestFlight from dev during the summit
